**Inspecting webhook settings**

I'm looking to inspect the webhook and see what's available. My first step is to search for the shell command `grep` to filter through the details. I want to make sure I get the right information about the webhook and any configurations related to it. This seems like a good way to streamline my search. Time to dive into the details and check what's there!
